subject: Re: Can't open saved rattle project - Error in set.cursor() : attempt to apply non-function

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: Can't open saved rattle project - Error in set.cursor() : attempt to apply non-function
parts:
There is an issue with loading projects in the current release of Rattle. 

Projects can still be loaded in older releases. 

It is under investigation - it arose with the recent move to ensure variables are not global - some fine tuning is required on restoring a project. 

Regards,

Graham Williams
http://togaware.com

messages.subject: Re: Can't open saved rattle project - Error in set.cursor() : attempt to apply non-function
parts:
Please note that the latest release of the beta version of Rattle has fixed this problem:

> install.packages("rattle", repo="http://rattle.togaware.com", type="source")

Version 2.6.26 r66

Saved projects can be loaded again!

Regards,
Graham
